item.description: British author Jeffrey Archer, who wrote a series of bestselling novels, served as a Conservative MP and was convicted of perjury, died suddenly at 86, his publisher HarperCollins said. Hassan Babar, the festival’s artistic director, said […] Fuente: Variety.
